import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_3.csv"
]

# Corresponding years for each source file, based on the target schema pattern
# Source 0 -> 2013, Source 1 -> 2014, Source 2 -> 2015, Source 3 -> 2016
years = [2013, 2014, 2015, 2016]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Each source has schema: ['Wrestler', 'Wins', 'Losses', 'Draws']
# Target schema has columns for each year: 'Wrestler', '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws', ..., '2016 Draws'

# Rename columns in each source df to include the year prefix
for i, year in enumerate(years):
    dfs[i] = dfs[i].rename(columns={
        'Wins': f'{year} Wins',
        'Losses': f'{year} Losses',
        'Draws': f'{year} Draws'
    })

# Now join all dfs on 'Wrestler' to get a wide table with all years' stats as separate columns
# Use outer join to keep all wrestlers appearing in any year
from functools import reduce

# Reduce with outer join on 'Wrestler'
df_merged = reduce(lambda left, right: pd.merge(left, right, on='Wrestler', how='outer'), dfs)

# After merge, some columns may have NaNs where a wrestler did not appear in a given year
# Fill NaNs with 0 and convert to int for all numeric columns except 'Wrestler'
numeric_cols = [col for col in df_merged.columns if col != 'Wrestler']
df_merged[numeric_cols] = df_merged[numeric_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Wrestler',
    '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
    '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
    '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
    '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws'
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read sources with index_col=0 to ignore numerical index column
s0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
s1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
s2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
s3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Rename columns to year-specific columns
s0 = s0.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws': '2013 Draws'
})

s1 = s1.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws': '2014 Draws'
})

s2 = s2.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws': '2015 Draws'
})

s3 = s3.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Join all sources on Wrestler
df = s0.merge(s1, on='Wrestler', how='outer')
df = df.merge(s2, on='Wrestler', how='outer')
df = df.merge(s3, on='Wrestler', how='outer')

# Fill NaN with 0 for numeric columns (Wins, Losses, Draws)
for col in df.columns:
    if col != 'Wrestler':
        df[col] = df[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['Wrestler',
                  '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
                  '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
                  '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
                  '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']

df = df[target_columns]

# Write output
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
